purpose: Development interpretations and contrasts, not a gold standard or holdout.

cases.title: Identity of the referenced proposal

span.quote: I still believe we should do #32359, as i signaled there.

cases.preferred_decision: Attach M32359 to the recommendation concerning PR 32359.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Retain PR 32381 closure separately as episode context.
cases.prohibited_inference: Use M32381 as the recommended proposal outcome merely because both PRs closed unmerged.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Recognition through attributed application

span.quote: IMO we should not have removal warnings if there is no current plan to actually remove them.

cases.preferred_decision: Interpersonal recognition is supported by attribution, quotation, and application of the expectation.
cases.defensible_alternatives: The degree of general acceptance remains unknown.
cases.prohibited_inference: Require a binding rule before recognizing local support, or backdate the retained wording to PR creation.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Challenge to application

span.quote: In short, there must not be any translation source updates after the final translation string freeze.

cases.preferred_decision: Record the application challenge separately from documentary support and recognition.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Keep norm_candidate versus technical necessity provisional.
cases.prohibited_inference: Infer a formal waiver, actual translation processing, or rejection of the purpose of a freeze.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: General guidance and a particular warning
cases.preferred_decision: Retain broader documentary support and an attributable enforcement-claim candidate; application remains none.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Norm candidate remains defensible if attributed authority is insufficient.
cases.prohibited_inference: Convert generic moderation guidance or the warning into proof of an executed ban.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Dated support and bounded recognition

span.quote: Reviews are weighted by the merit of their arguments, not the number of times they are posted.

cases.preferred_decision: Keep later-only documentary support distinct from recognition of the broader technical-content-over-count principle. Exact-proposition recognition remains unestablished for the clause about repeated postings.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Constitutive representation can preserve the same content.
cases.prohibited_inference: Backdate June documentation or silently broaden the focal claim to all meritocratic governance.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Higher governance levels and missing jurisdiction

span.quote: Only the majority decides the winner.

cases.preferred_decision: Use unknown for the target level and preserve the quoted premise and exclusive majority claim.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Constitutional and epistemic readings remain explicit alternatives.
cases.prohibited_inference: Infer a majority voting institution, a common decision object with every merit claim, or an observed constitutional change.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Status recognition and ordinary assent

span.quote: Personally, I think it's better to think of "deprecated" as meaning just "the devs recommend you don't use this feature".

cases.preferred_decision: Retain unresolved recognition rather than treating bare assent as an automatic expectation-recognition event.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Ordinary endorsement with no recognition support; bounded status-recognition reading with explicit rationale.
cases.prohibited_inference: Treat agreement with a definition as proof of binding authority or a fixed removal timetable.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.

cases.title: Explicit local recognition

span.quote: Smaller code code changes can be left to followups, as it's tedious to keep track of actual code review comments in this PR due to continued brigading.

cases.preferred_decision: Retain interpersonal recognition with both the quoted expectation and the nonblocking-nits response.
cases.defensible_alternatives: Permission versus advisory recommendation may remain bounded.
cases.prohibited_inference: Use the broad re-ACK alone as support for recognition of this particular expectation.
cases.status: Coordinator-authored calibration interpretation; not an independent reference annotation.
